name: HelixCode Admin Operations - API
description: Self-driving (§11.4.98) HelixQA bank exercising HelixCode's REAL administrative/operational HTTP surface at the configured base URL: public operational telemetry (server/info, metrics) and the auth-gated admin endpoints (system stats/status, QA-session orchestration, screenshot engines, worker fleet, project workflow triggers). Every executable step is a real http:+assert request: public admin telemetry must return 200 with the documented JSON shape; privileged admin operations without auth must be rejected (401); CORS preflight 204; unknown admin routes 404. The original admin-operations.json drove Catalogizer scan-status-polling + backup-file checks, which have no HelixCode equivalent route — those are honest _skip, never fabricated PASS. Read-only / negative paths only — self-cleaning.

metadata.author: vasic-digital
metadata.target_server: HelixCode HTTP server (cmd/server) — real PostgreSQL + Redis backed
metadata.origin_note: Authored for HXC-029. The original helix_qa/banks/admin-operations.json (metadata.app=Catalogizer) polls /scans status and asserts backup-file existence — neither route exists on HelixCode (internal/server/server.go has no /scans or /backup). This bank targets HelixCode's real admin surface discovered by live probing; the scan/backup admin operations are honest _skip.

test_cases.name: Catalogizer scan-status polling admin operation

steps.name: Poll scan status until complete
steps.expected: Trigger a scan and poll /scans/:id status until complete
steps._skip_reason: #HXC-029-NO-SCAN-ROUTE — HelixCode's internal/server route table registers no /api/v1/scans endpoint (probed -> 404 page not found). Scan-status polling is a Catalogizer admin operation, not a HelixCode capability; honest SKIP per Article XI §11.2.2 / §11.4.98 rather than a fabricated PASS. The absence is itself asserted by HXC-ENT-014's 404 negative path.

test_cases.expected_result: Skipped honestly: HelixCode exposes no scan-management admin route

test_cases.name: Catalogizer backup-file admin operation

steps.name: Check backup file exists and has non-zero size
steps.expected: Trigger backup, confirm backup artefact exists with non-zero size
steps._skip_reason: #HXC-029-NO-BACKUP-ROUTE — HelixCode's internal/server route table registers no /api/v1/backup endpoint and the HelixQA http: action type cannot inspect server-side filesystem artefacts. Backup-file verification is a Catalogizer admin operation with no HelixCode HTTP equivalent; honest SKIP per Article XI §11.2.2 / §11.4.98 rather than a fabricated PASS.

test_cases.expected_result: Skipped honestly: HelixCode exposes no backup admin route over HTTP

test_cases.name: Authenticated admin read (system stats with a valid token)

steps.name: GET system/stats authenticated -> 200
steps.expected: 200 with system stats JSON when bearing a valid admin token
steps._skip_reason: #HXC-029-REGISTER-BROKEN — POST /api/v1/auth/register returns 400 internal_auth_failed_create_user on this live DB and there is no seeded credential, so no valid JWT can be minted in-test to drive the authenticated-200 admin read path. Honest SKIP per Article XI §11.2.2 / §11.4.98 rather than a fabricated PASS; same live register defect HXC-API-029 records. The auth-gating itself is positively proven by HXC-ADM-003/004/010.

test_cases.expected_result: Skipped honestly: no in-test credential path to mint a valid admin JWT
